summary: Integrated all six v15 audit findings files into the data and wrote docs/audit/v15/CORRECTIONS.md (116 KB, 9 sections): every one of the 517 findings has a row with a final disposition — 114 applied (before → after stated), 25 rejected with the basis that outranked them, 4 open (unverifiable-here, no fix invented), 375 verified-ok. Applied the critical/major defects: the MCA no longer claims Parkinson's or Wallenberg (SYN-001/002 = VN-001/002 = architect D1), Foville's gaze palsy direction, Weber/Millard-Gubler/INO/hemimedullary structure lists, the MCA-angular and thalamogeniculate vascular attributions, 8 ventricle CSF-flow inversions (dienc-001…008), the chiasm cluster (both chiasm records moved onto the committed chiasm mesh, 0.14 au from it), nuc-snc/snr anchors 4.4-4.9 au onto their own casts, three cranial-nerve exit landmarks moved off/out of the pons and the inferior olive with their course waypoints and the curves.ts regeneration, 12 level-set/plate-label reconciliations, 16 somatotopy level trims, ~30 nomenclature/clinical text corrections, 2 inverted plate A/P frames and 5 plate leader dots. Rejected 25 with reasons (e.g. VN-010: the hemiballismus card itself names the anterior choroidal artery; VN-016: the CN IV calibre arithmetic is already consistent; T3-0010: anterior-choroidal pallidal supply is textbook; the laterality flags change render-time mirroring that this sandbox cannot observe; brainstem-013 would contradict a plate manifest on the strength of a possibly-short mesh). DISPLAY-TIME ONLY: no mesh moved — git status shows 0 changes under src/assets/ and all 138 manifest parts re-measure bbox-exact against their committed GLBs. Verified: validate 0 errors/0 warnings (225 structures, 23 tracts, 26 syndromes, 248 registry rows), check, build, verify:pipeline 138/138 parts, verify:plane 10827 assertions, verify:somatotopy, verify:cortical-lobes, verify:view-filter-consistency, verify:area-toggles 455, verify:division-toggles, verify:audit-checks, verify:closure-bite, verify:boundary-contract, verify:a11y-contract, verify:budget-report, verify:pip-contract, verify:plane-helper-extent, verify:cranial-nerves 451, verify:nerve-kind, verify:cranial-nerve-courses 220 (it asserts the three moved landmarks are literal waypoints), verify:cranial-nerve-render — all exit 0. verify:anatomy and verify:imaging-fit cannot complete in this agent sandbox (spawnSync powershell/node EPERM before any verdict; plan §C3b), so 27/27 remains an orchestrator-lane number and the local substitute is the 138/138 bbox re-measurement. INCIDENT DISCLOSED IN THE LEDGER (§6): an editor self-test of mine wrote 11 data files mid-run; all were restored and independently verified byte-exact (9 from HEAD with size + git-clean proof, taxonomy.json = HEAD + its 12 nrv rows, and the two untracked nerve files rebuilt from the committed dist bundle — deep-equal to it, 216/216 surviving fields agreeing, and .dsh-swarm/_regen-curves.mjs re-derives the committed curves.ts byte-identically from them). package.json was left untouched. Write-scope deviations, both named in the ledger: src/geometry/curves.ts plus .dsh-swarm/_curves-block.txt (the plan's T7 recipe requires the pair, and a stale block would silently revert the three nerve-course fixes).
